content: Memu'axɨa mawari wewiwamete meta rewitsixi
'Ikɨ mawari wewiwamete mekanihɨkɨtɨni meta rewitsixi memu'axɨa Tsuruwaweri hamatɨa Tsaratiheri nu'aya, meta Ketsuha hamatɨa: Tserahiyaxi, Keremiyaxi, 'Etsitɨraxi,
'Amariyaxi, Maruki, Katuxi,
Tsekaniyaxi, Xekuni, Meremuti,
'Iru, Kinetuni, 'Awiyaxi,
Mikamini, Mariyaxi, Wirika,
Tsemahiyaxi, Kuyariwi, Kerahiyaxi,
Tsaru, 'Amuki, Kirikiyaxi meta Kerahiyaxi. 'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni memanuyetei mawari wewiwamete meta wamarema Ketsuha muyeikakaitsie.

Rewitsixi mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni Ketsuha, Winuhi, Karimieri, Tserewiyaxi, Kura meta Mataniyaxi, kepauka Kakaɨyari pamɨpariyutsi mukupitɨariwakai mɨkɨ pɨhɨritɨariekai 'ana memutikwikanikɨ yu'iwama yunaitɨ.
Wakuwukiyaxi meta 'Unihi, memɨwa'iwama, wahɨxie mekaniti'uwekaitɨni mewaranutaxeiyatɨ memutikwikakaitsie.
Ketsuha xiɨyarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni Kuhakimi, 'Eriyatsiwi, Kuyara,
Kuhanahani meta Karuha.
Mawari wewiwamete wa'ukiyarima, Kuhakimi ti'aitakaku 'ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni: Tserahiyaxi nuiwarimama: Merahiyaxi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Keremiyaxi nuiwarimama: Kananiyaxi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
'Etsitɨraxi nuiwarimama: Metsurani puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, 'Amariyaxi nuiwarimama: Kuhanahani puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
Meriku nuiwarimama: Kunatani puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Tsewaniyaxi nuiwarimama: Kutse puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
Karini nuiwarimama: 'Arɨna puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Merayuti nuiwarimama: Kerikahi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
'Iru nuiwarimama: Tsakariyaxi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Kinetuni nuiwarimama: Metsurani puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
'Awiyaxi nuiwarimama: Tsikɨri puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Minikamini nuiwarimama: mɨkɨta yuxeime yu'ukiyari mepexeiyakai, Muhariyaxi nuiwarimama: Piritahi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
Wirika nuiwarimama: Tsamuha puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Tsemahiyaxi nuiwarimama: Kunatani puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
Kuyariwi nuiwarimama: Matenahi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Kerahiyaxi nuiwarimama: 'Utsihi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
Tsarahi nuiwarimama: Karahi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, 'Amuki nuiwarimama: 'Ewexi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai,
Kirikiyaxi nuiwarimama: Katsawiyaxi puwa'ukiyaritɨkai, Kerahiyaxi nuiwarimama: Natanaheri puwa'ukiyaritɨkai.

Kepauka 'Eriyatsiwi, Kuyara, Kuhanahani meta Karuha mawari wewiwamete wa'ukiyarima memɨhɨkɨtɨkaitsie rewitsixi wa'ukiyarima meta mawari wewiwamete wa'ukiyarima mekanaka'utsieni Raríyu ti'aitakaku Peritsiya kiekame.
Rewitsixi wa'ukiyarima Kuhanahani 'Eriyatsiwi nu'aya muyeikakaitsie xeikɨari mekanaka'utsieni kemɨtiuyɨ xapayaritsie.

Rewitsixi wa'ukiyarima mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni Katsawiyaxi, Tserewiyaxi meta Ketsuha Karimieri nu'aya. Kepauka maye'axekai memɨtikwika wa'iwama mɨkɨ wahɨxie mekaniti'uwekaitɨni memɨtikwikakɨ meta pamɨpariyutsi memipitɨanikɨ, Rawiri kemɨtiu'aitaxɨ, tewi Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme.
Mataniyaxi, Wakuwukiyaxi, 'Awiriyaxi, Metsurani, Tarimuni meta 'Akuwi kitenie tehɨwemete mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni meta mɨtiuyepitɨkatsie kitenie 'aurie.

Yunaitɨ 'ikɨ Kuhakimi Ketsuha nu'aya meta Kutsaraki teukarieya muyeikakaitsie mekaniu'uwakaitɨni, meta Nehemiyaxi mukuwexinaruritɨkaitsie, meta mawari wewiwame meta ti'ɨkitame 'Etsitɨraxi mɨhɨkɨtɨkaitsie.
'Ixɨarari kuraru hetsiemieme

Kepauka maye'a kuraru hetsiemieme 'ixɨarari memɨwewienikɨ, mekaniwarutiwauni rewitsixi naitsarie kememɨte'ukutetɨkatei mekaniwarewitɨni, Kerutsareme 'ixɨarari memɨwewienikɨ kwikarikɨ meta pamɨpariyutsi me'ipitɨatɨ, meteyuitɨatɨ mɨtiutitiraurɨkakɨ, 'aripakɨ meta 'aripa 'etsimupekɨ.
Hikɨ mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni kwikamete Kerutsareme 'aurie kiekatari meta Netupa 'aurie kiekarite 'etsimɨyeyeutsie kiekatari,
meta Weti-Kirikari kiekatari, yaxeikɨatsiere Kehewa kwieyaritsie kiekatari meta 'Atsimaweti kiekatari, mɨkɨ Kerutsareme 'aurie mekaniuyutikitɨakaitɨni kwikamete.
Mawari wewiwamete meta rewitsixi me'uyu'itieka meri, 'ariketa teɨteri, meta kiteniete, metatsiere kuraru mekateniu'itieni.

Hikɨ Kura kwieyaritsie kiekatari memanuyetei yanekatiniwarutahɨawe memanutikɨnekɨ kurarutsie, meta kwikamete meyumɨireme nekaniwarukuxeɨrieni me'ayehutame. Hipatɨ tatserieta meneutayune kuraru hetsie me'uhutɨ, Xatsi kitenieyari hepa me'erietɨ,
kwikamete wa'utɨa 'Utsahiyaxi kaniumiekaitɨni Kura kwieyaritsie memanuyetei warawitɨtɨ,
'Atsariyaxi, 'Etsitɨraxi, Metsurani,
Kura, Wenikamini, Tsemahiyaxi meta Keremiyaxi.
'Ikɨ mekaniwaruweiyakaitɨni mawari wewiwamete kuxineta me'u'ɨtɨ: Tsakariyaxi Kunatani nu'aya, Tsemahiyaxi nu'aya, Mataniyaxi nu'aya, Mikahiyaxi nu'aya, Tsakuxi nu'aya, 'Atsahapi nu'aya,

meta maremama Tsemahiyaxi, 'Atsareri, Mirarahi, Kirarahi, Mahi, Natanaheri, Kura meta Kananihi, kanarite memu'ɨkai Rawiri tipiinieya, tewi Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme. Matsi yunaime wahɨxie ti'ɨkitame 'Etsitɨraxi kaniumiekaitɨni.

Haixata kitenieyaritsie meye'axɨaka, heitserie mekaneutiyune teikɨmana tetexi 'imɨmɨiyari 'amatayewatsie Rawiri kiekariena, kuraru teikɨmana meutiyunetsie, Rawiri paratsiyuya manuwe 'aurie muyehanetsie mekaniuyekɨne, Haa kitenieyaritsie paitɨ mekaniye'axɨani, tau manatineika hepatsie.

Hutarieka miemete kwikamete ta'utata meneutayune memanuyukunakekɨ, Huxunu tuxiyuyari kuraruyari 'utɨma meta kuraru 'amatayewa 'utɨma. Ne wa'utɨa nekaniumiekaitɨni, hipame teɨteri hixɨapa memɨ'axe newarawitɨtɨ.

Kitenie 'Epɨrahini mɨtitewa heima tekaniuyekɨne meta Ketsahana heima, meta kitenie Tsapari mɨtitewa heima, tuxiyu Kananeri mɨtitewa hetsie meta tuxiyu Xeitsienituyari mɨtitewatsie meta Muxatsi wakitenie mɨtitewatsie, 'atsita Kuyaxi kitenie mɨtitewatsie paitɨ tekaniye'axɨani. Mana tekaniwa'uni.
Kwikamete memayehuta tukita 'aixɨa mekateniuyu'uitɨani. Yaxeikɨata ne meta memanuyetei hixɨapa memɨ'axe 'aixɨa tekateniuyu'uitɨani,
meta mawari wewiwamete 'Eriyakini, Matsehiyaxi, Minikamini, Mikahiyaxi, 'Erihuhenahi, Tsakariyaxi, Kananiyaxi,
Matsehiyaxi, Tsemahiyaxi, 'Eriyatsaxi, 'Utsihi, Kuhanahani, Marikiyaxi, 'Erami meta 'Etsexi, mekateniukayuitɨwakaitɨni meta mekaniutikwikakaitɨni yutɨrɨkarima, 'Itsirahiyaxi mɨtiwa'aitɨa pɨhɨkɨtɨkai.

Mɨkɨ tukaritsie mawari waɨkawa kaniuwewiyani meta 'ixɨarari mepuwewi Kakaɨyari temawierika muwarupitɨakɨ. Metatsiere 'ukarawetsixi meta tɨɨri mepɨte'uparewi. Yemekɨ waɨkawa temawierika Kerutsareme puxuawekai teewapaitɨ mepɨ'enieriekai.
Kemɨtiyetuiwa mawari wewiwamete meta rewitsixi wahetsiemieme

Mɨkɨ tukaritsie, mekaniutihɨawarieni 'imikierite mɨtiwati'utsiwa memɨhɨritɨarieni, matɨari mɨtiukaxuxuawere, tamamatatsie timieme. Mɨkɨ naitsarie mepɨtehatɨtɨkɨkani mɨraka'etsitɨre timieme kiekarite 'aurie, 'inɨari niukiyari kemɨti'aita, mawari wewiwamete wahetsiemieme meta rewitsixi. Teɨteri Kura kwieyaritsie kiekatari waɨkawa mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni mawari wewiwamete meta rewitsixi wahetsiemieme kememɨte'uximayakai,

mɨkɨ wahetsiemieme kememɨte'u'aitakai Rawiri meta nu'aya Tsarumuni mɨpaɨ mekateni'uximayakaitɨni Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme meta 'itiya hepaɨtsita mekateni'uximayakaitɨni, kwikamete meyɨnɨtɨ meta kitenie tehɨwemete.
Mɨixa wiyari panuyemie kepauka Rawiri muyeikakaitsie meta 'Atsahapi, 'ana mepɨte'ukatsutɨa mewarexeiyatɨ kwikamete wa'ukiyarima, nɨawari memutikwika meta pamɨpariyutsi memipitɨa Kakaɨyari.

Tsuruwaweri muyeikakaitsie meta Nehemiyaxi, 'ixaheritsixi yamepɨteyetuayakai ketipaɨmetɨ memutikwika mɨtiwahetsiemieme meta kitenie tehɨwemete. Metatsiere 'imikierite mekaniyetuayakaitɨni rewitsixi wahetsiemieme, mɨkɨta rewitsixi 'Aruni niwemama mepɨtewayetuiriwakai ketipaɨmetɨ mɨtiwahetsiemiemetɨkai.
